data: Microsoft reported operating income of about $109.4 billion for fiscal 2024, the year ended June 30, 2024. That was up roughly 24% from $88.5 billion in fiscal 2023. Amazon reported operating income of about $68.6 billion for fiscal 2024, which is the calendar year ended December 31, 2024. That was up from $36.9 billion in 2023, with AWS contributing roughly $39.8 billion of the total. Microsoft's figure was therefore about 1.6 times Amazon's, roughly $40.8 billion more. The two fiscal years are offset by six months, and Amazon's revenue of about $638 billion was far larger than Microsoft's $245 billion. So Microsoft's lead comes from much higher margins, about 45% against Amazon's roughly 11%.
